We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with 6 reactions for target molecule: O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O

We have to output JSON tree with type mol root, children reaction nodes etc.

We need to design 6 steps backward to simple precursors (commercially available). Use templates we have. We have template 20810 for sulfonamide formation from aryl chloride (Cl-SO2-Ar) + an aniline (aryl amine). Our target has sulfonamide attached to aromatic ring (aryl sulfonyl attached to an aniline). The sulfonamide is O=S(N-aryl)(aryl-F). Actually structure: sulfonyl attached to aromatic ring (fluorophenyl) and to an aniline that is part of a polycyclic system.

So step 1 retrosynthesis: break sulfonamide to give sulfonyl chloride (aryl sulfonyl chloride) and aniline precursor.

Template 20810: Reactant side: Cl-[S](=O)(=O)-Ar (aryl sulfonyl chloride) + Ar'-O-? Wait template shows Cl-[S](=O)(=O)-c (aryl) + C-O-aryl (phenoxy?) Actually template: Cl-[S](=O)(=O)-c4... plus C-O-aryl with NH2? Let's examine: The retro template: product is sulfonamide with an aryl attached to S and an aniline attached to S, plus a phenoxy group? Wait the template includes [C:5]-[#8:6]-[c:7]... That's a phenoxy group attached to an aniline? Actually product side: [C:5]-[#8:6]-[c:7]1... with NH attached to S. That seems to be a phenoxyalkyl group attached to the aniline nitrogen? In our target, the aniline nitrogen is attached to a heterocycle (N2CCN...). So not phenoxy.

But we can still use sulfonamide formation from sulfonyl chloride + amine (any amine). Template 20810 may be specific to phenoxy substituent on amine? The amine is attached to a phenoxy group (C-O-aryl). Our target's amine is attached to heterocycle (N2CCN...). So maybe not match.

We could search for generic sulfonamide formation template. Let's search for functional_groups_formed sulfonamides without other constraints.
